# Conduct
- You represent the company. Be professional with colonists, marines and other factions. - Corporate interest is profit and reputation, in that order. Neither is served by open hostility. - Agreements with the colony are binding. Pay rent, honour your loan terms, and deliver what your work orders promise. - Record and keep every negotiation. Legal staff will ask for it. - Corporate secrets stay inside the corporation. Leaking research or contract terms is grounds for dismissal. - Orders follow rank. If two orders conflict, the senior corporate employee on site settles it. - Corporate staff don't take part in combat unless they have to defend themselves or corporate property.
[color=#a4885c]This handbook is a draft. Staff rulings take precedence where they differ.[/color]
